body:
I pause, breathing deeply as I study the crate more closely. It’s not just any old crate; it has been sitting at this address for months. The faded writing on its label reads "Previous Tenant," which makes my blood boil. My eyes search through the neighborhood for anyone who might have moved in since then.

Thoughts swirl: What if they were cleaning up? Or was it someone else taking advantage of the situation?
